dataset.ground_truth: Simulator reference labels; not independent real-driver annotations

protocol.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of three target-class F1 values; undefined class P/R becomes zero
protocol.unknown: Unusable engine status is scored UNKNOWN, remains an error in all denominators
protocol.strict_detection: One-to-one new predicted DROWSY onset inside a labelled half-open interval
protocol.coverage: Any DROWSY interval overlap; preexisting alerts reported separately, no negative latency
protocol.false_events: All predicted DROWSY onsets not strictly matched; late alerts remain false
protocol.late_alerts: Unmatched onset within five seconds after an unmatched labelled episode; diagnostic only
protocol.duration: Left-constant source intervals; final interval is median positive source dt
protocol.state_changes: state_changes/evaluated_prediction_changes include UNKNOWN abstention transitions; driver_state_changes counts native state changes; availability_status_changes is null for legacy methods without status outputs
protocol.legacy_comparison: Original decision functions are unchanged; strict one-to-one onset scoring intentionally differs from the old overlap plus five-second grace, so event-count changes are metric changes, not algorithm changes
protocol.latency: Nonnegative onset delay, pooled over strictly matched episodes only; null if none
protocol.fairness: Identical six-field input rows; labels are allowlist-excluded from every engine call
protocol.selection: Development comparison, not an independent held-out or real-video accuracy estimate

environment.timing_scope: Local CPU decision processing only; Jetson FPS/memory not measured

processing_benchmark.scope: whole-drive decision processing; parsing, metrics, plots and file I/O excluded
processing_benchmark.limitation: Batch amortized CPU timings, not per-callback p95, alert delay or Jetson measurements
